_doc: Move specific appearances off a shared same-name record onto their own person, BEFORE apply_merges. Run by split_appearances.py right after split_swilliams. Each rule: from (canonical_name + source), the appearances whose context starts with context_prefix, and the new person's canonical_name. 'renames' fix a record's display name by id; 'move_refs' move Winch reference notes (matched by note prefix) from one record to another.

rules.context_prefix: Reform lectures of John Allen in Pittsburgh
rules.note: North Star, Feb. 18, 1848: a Massachusetts land reformer lecturing in Pittsburgh. Not the John Allen who was secretary of the 1827 Protecting Society; split off 2026-11-01 so that record could merge into Winch's Allen, John (Michiko's ruling).

rules.context_prefix: Institute for Colored Youth -- Association of Alumni
rules.note: The 1861 ICY Alumni Association treasurer Joseph White is the ICY graduate (Coppin roster), not the 1838 census householder of the same name. Run #76, 2026-11-01.

rules.context_prefix: Notice: Association of Alumni of the Institute for Colored Youth
rules.note: The 1861 ICY Alumni Association treasurer Joseph White is the ICY graduate (Coppin roster), not the 1838 census householder of the same name. Run #76, 2026-11-01.

Winch 'Gibbs, Jonathan C.' is the FATHER (Methodist minister, d. April 1831). Every 1860s Christian Recorder item (ICY and Banneker lectures, SCSA civil-rights committee, 1861 marriages) is the SON, Rev. Jonathan C. Gibbs (b. 1821; Winch 'Gibbs, Rev. Jonathan C.', PA Equal Rights League 1865). Caught in Run #77, 2026-11-01.
Correspondent from Evesham, N.J. (Burlington Circuit Sabbath School celebration, CR Oct. 1861); not the Philadelphia census Joseph Thompson. Run #77.
Signer of 'Letter from Brother Smith' (CR Dec. 21, 1861), place not stated; not linked to the census James W. Smith. Run #77.
1860s Christian Recorder items printed 'Jonathan C. Gibbs' are the son, Rev. Jonathan C. Gibbs (Winch id 1136, stable). Needed once the father's record became 'Gibbs, Jonathan C. Sr.' (2026-11-01).

renames.name: Colley, Daniel
renames.note: Winch heads this entry 'Colly or Colley, D[aniel]' (bootmaker, tanner and currier, 189 S. 6th; Vigilance Committee 1839); the import had taken a later line as his name. Michiko confirmed 2026-11-01.

renames.name: Mead, Mary
renames.note: Carries the death date from Winch 'Meade, Mary' (d. 1854), merged into this record 2026-11-01.

renames.name: Gibbs, Rev. Jonathan C.
renames.note: Dates from the 1838 Black Metropolis blog post 'The Gibbs Brothers Run the World' (born 1821, died 1874).

renames.name: Gibbs, Jonathan C. Sr.
renames.aliases: Gibbs, Jonathan C. | Jonathan Clarkson Gibbs Sr.
renames.note: Father, Rev. Jonathan Clarkson Gibbs Sr. (d. April 1831). 'Sr.' added 2026-11-01 (Michiko) to tell him from his son Rev. Jonathan C. Gibbs. 'Rev.' is kept out of the record name so that 1860s 'Jonathan Gibbs' items still reach the issue_like rule that moves them to the son.
